Home at 7, tired, and supper still isn't cooked. Each range below takes one of those jobs off your hands. Come to Safari Plaza and we'll switch anything on so you can see it work.

Questions

Before you buy.

Still unsure? Call or WhatsApp us and we'll answer straight away.

How much does it cost?

Pick an item from the dropdown under each product range to see its price. For anything else, send us the product name on WhatsApp (07XX XXX XXX) or call 0700 000 001, and we'll send you the price and photos.

Does it really work like the TikTok video?

Yes. Come to Shop 100 and we'll switch it on for you, so you see it working before you pay.

Is it in stock?

Each item in the product dropdowns shows whether it's in stock. Our most popular items sell fast, so call or WhatsApp before you come, and we'll confirm it's on the shelf and set one aside for you.

Can I pay with M-Pesa?

Yes. At the shop you can pay with M-Pesa using our Till number (Buy Goods). Ask us for the Till number on WhatsApp or at the counter.

Where exactly is the shop?

Safari Plaza, Shop 100, on the first floor, next to the main food court. Open in Google Maps
